# Rosvik V22 third-party models

V22 downloads a small, curated set of text-based OBJ meshes into this folder when Unity builds the hero slice. Materials from the source packs are deliberately not imported; Rosvik applies its own consistent materials.

## Kenney Nature Kit 2.1
- Creator: Kenney / https://kenney.nl/
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Source used by the editor downloader: public GitHub mirror `ETdoFresh/kenney.nl`, folder `kenney_natureKit_2.1/Models/OBJ format/`
- Models used: `tree_pineDefaultA`, `tree_pineTallA`, `tree_default_fall`, `plant_bushDetailed`, `rock_smallA`

The source pack's `License.txt` explicitly states CC0 and permits personal, educational and commercial use.

## KayKit City Builder Bits 1.0
- Creator: Kay Lousberg / https://kaylousberg.com/
- License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)
- Source: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-City-Builder-Bits-1.0
- Models used: `streetlight`, `bench`, `car_hatchback`

The source repository's `LICENSE.txt` explicitly states CC0 and permits personal, educational and commercial use.

No attribution is required by either pack, but this file keeps the provenance clear for the project.
